target: 5-class sleep stage (W, N1, N2, N3, REM), from the technician-scored hypnogram
reference: HMC hypnogram annotations (sleep technician scoring), not model-derived
experiment_type: A/B/C sensor marginal-value ablation, independent-family replication of this project's Sleep-EDF EEG-vs-EEG+EOG finding

eeg_channel_selection.rationale: C4/M1 is the central-derivation channel, the closest anatomical/montage analog to Sleep-EDF's Fpz-Cz/Pz-Oz central placement among HMC's four options, and central EEG is the most commonly retained derivation in wearable-relevant sleep-staging literature when only one channel is available. F4 (frontal) and O2 (occipital) are single-region alternatives; C3/M2 is the redundant contralateral pair to C4/M1 and was not chosen only to avoid an arbitrary tie-break with no anatomical reason to prefer one hemisphere. Frozen before any training; will not be changed based on results.

eog_derivation.polarity: E1 minus E2, fixed (not sign-flipped per subject)
eog_derivation.missing_channel_behavior: If either E1/M2 or E2/M2 is absent for a given recording, that recording is excluded from B/C (data-integrity rule, not imputed).

control_C.destroys: temporal correspondence between EEG and EOG within an epoch
preserves: realistic EOG signal distribution (drawn from a different epoch of the SAME subject's real EOG recording)
control_C.rng: Independent, isolated RNG role (control_shuffle_seed) derived per ml/sleep_seed_utils.py's sub-seed convention, generated independently of hypnogram labels.

seed_protocol.note: Historical Sleep-EDF trainers' buggy order (seed applied after model construction) is NOT reused for HMC - HMC is a brand-new trainer to be written, so it starts from the corrected protocol directly rather than needing a later fix.

split_strategy.method: Subject-wise (== recording-wise) k-fold, no epoch-level split, no repeated-night grouping logic needed (confirmed no repeat nights exist in this database).

stage_mapping.unknown_movement_unscored_handling: Epochs labeled unknown/movement/unscored in the hypnogram are excluded from both training and evaluation (data-integrity exclusion, applied identically to A/B/C, frozen before training, never revisited based on results).

leakage_exclusions: F4/O2/C3 (unused derivations, out of scope not leakage)
subject_sensitivity: Report per-subject A-vs-B delta across all eligible subjects (151 candidate), favorable-direction count, dominance/concentration, matching this project's existing Sleep-EDF per-subject reporting convention.
capacity_control: Architecture-matched dual-channel-input Conv1D encoder identical in width/depth to this project's existing Sleep-EDF SleepStageClassifier convention, adapted for HMC's 256 Hz input rate.

negative_result_policy.if_candidate_helps: Report as: 'EOG added sleep-staging information under an independent replication (HMC), on a clinically heterogeneous cohort distinct from Sleep-EDF's healthy-volunteer population.'
negative_result_policy.if_candidate_does_not_help: Report as: 'the Sleep-EDF EOG benefit did not reproduce on HMC's clinical cohort' - a real, retained negative result, not discarded.
negative_result_policy.if_shuffled_control_equals_candidate: Report: apparent EOG benefit attributable to capacity/context, not temporal correspondence.
negative_result_policy.if_effect_sign_flips_vs_sleep_edf: Report both findings side by side; consider (but do not assume) that population heterogeneity (clinical referrals vs. healthy volunteers) is a plausible contributing factor, offered as a hypothesis not a proven mechanism.

forbidden_claims: EOG is necessary for sleep staging.
HMC replicates Sleep-EDF (use 'independent-family reproduction attempt', not 'replication').
Chin EMG or ECG lead II are safe staging inputs.
implementation_cost: MEDIUM-HIGH (15.7 GB total, 151 EDF files, largest of the currently-in-repo sleep datasets by file count)
workflow_dependency: GO_WITH_DEPENDENCY - full HMC Stage-2 training should not begin until Claude/Emir's Stage 1A Sleep V2 protocol/state is frozen, per Section 29's explicit instruction. The dataset itself has no scientific blocker; the dependency is purely about not building on a Sleep protocol that may still change under Claude's parallel integration work.
classification_reason: All required facts verified directly (RECORDS index, PhysioNet page): confirmed 1-recording-per-subject (no repeat-night grouping trap), confirmed uniform 256 Hz across all channels (no H2-style per-channel mismatch), clean CC-BY open access. The only limiting factor is the workflow dependency on Claude's Stage 1A Sleep V2 freeze, not a data or design flaw - hence GO_WITH_DEPENDENCY rather than plain GO or a limitation-driven GO_WITH_LIMITATIONS.
